edge_cases: Calling FakeChannel.json_body or .code before any response has been written raises an exception.
Providing a non‑bytes method or path to make_request triggers automatic ASCII encoding.
Supplying an unknown hostname to the resolver results in a failed Deferred with DNSLookupError.
Passing a dict as content to make_request is JSON‑encoded; passing a non‑dict non‑bytes raises no error but may produce malformed payloads.
If access_token is None, no Authorization header is added; malformed tokens are not validated here.
When federation_auth_origin is set, an Authorization header with placeholder signature is added, which may be rejected by downstream logic.
contract.intent: Provide test utilities for the Sydent identity server, including functions to create a test Sydent instance, fabricate HTTP requests/responses, configure logging, and supply a memory‑based Twisted reactor with fake DNS resolution.
invariants: If no "db" entry is supplied to make_sydent, an in‑memory SQLite DB is always used.
make_request always prefixes paths that do not start with "/_matrix" with "/_matrix/identity/v2/".
All request bodies are encoded as UTF‑8 JSON bytes before being placed in the request.
FakeChannel stores response data in a dict under keys "code", "headers", "body", and "done".
ResolvingMemoryReactorClock's nameResolver only resolves names present in its internal lookups dict.
io_behavior: make_sydent returns a Sydent object configured with an in‑memory SQLite DB and a custom reactor.
make_request builds a FakeChannel and a Request, writes the supplied body to the request, and returns both objects.
FakeChannel records HTTP status code, headers, and body which can be inspected via its properties.
ToTwistedHandler forwards Python logging records to Twisted's logging system.
ResolvingMemoryReactorClock resolves hostnames using an internal dict, returning a Deferred that succeeds or fails.
FAKE_SERVER_CERT_PEM is loaded as a TLS certificate when getPeerCertificate() is called on a FakeChannel.

side_effects: Adds a ToTwistedHandler to the root Python logger and sets its level based on SYDENT_TEST_LOG_LEVEL.
Initialises a global OpenSSL certificate object each time getPeerCertificate() is accessed.
Modifies the global name resolution mapping in ResolvingMemoryReactorClock instances.
Potentially creates files or sockets only if the underlying Sydent code does so (outside this module).
Registers the custom reactor class with Twisted's IReactorPluggableNameResolver interface.
May raise exceptions if FakeChannel properties are accessed before a result is written.

rationale: Core functionality is present, but key invariants (path prefix handling, FakeChannel dict storage, done flag) are not fully met; most edge cases and side‑effects are correctly implemented, leading to moderate overall preservation.
